question:
Which letter-cluster will replace the question mark (?) to complete the given series?

SWBM, OSXI, ?, GKPA, CGLW
solution:
The position and positional values of English Alphabets are as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a61a53229cbaf2530dbd2db83febb9a49b784ffdc708e2ef355b6ba94bac6715.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a431a37e0dad4ba2c4f7e18ac3e1329dd7e5b4a49fc52049f30aa21e01ba98cb.png] 

So, **KOTE ** will replace the question mark.

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 2'.***
